rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Gemini MCP server by emmron provides AI-powered codebase analysis through OpenRouter's API integration, offering comprehensive code quality assessment, security vulnerability scanning, and performance profiling capabilities. The implementation combines static code analysis with advanced features including OWASP Top 10 security mapping, dependency vulnerability scanning with CVE database integration, code similarity detection for clone analysis, and AI-powered code smell detection with automatic fix suggestions. Built with task management functionality and extensive AST-based analysis, it's particularly valuable for development teams needing automated code review, security auditing, and technical debt assessment across JavaScript/TypeScript codebases with detailed reporting on maintainability metrics, architectural patterns, and optimization recommendations.
